verdict.rationale: ADK documents a graph-based workflow runtime (loops, retry, state management) and deployment to Cloud Run, Agent Runtime, GKE or Docker. Those are developer building blocks and hosting options for agents that are 'accessed, queried, and used', not a documented feature for setting up automations that run autonomously in the background. The pack has no evidence of scheduled, recurring or event-triggered background runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
